propositions: External and live-service CI lanes lack per-test hang guards present in the shared suite, allowing deadlocked tests to hide behind summary output without identifying the culprit.

Eight unguarded pytest lanes (six in external-integration.yml, plus _eval-discipline and _optionality) need calibrated per-test timeout budgets derived from historical runtime data and live-service variance.

The parity assertion in test_ci_workflow_parity.py is too narrow (filtering on --dist and -m flags), causing it to miss non-xdist and bare-path pytest invocations; it must be replaced with an exhaustive regex-based detection across all .github/workflows files.
Per-test budgets must be set to at least 10x the lane's observed mean per-test duration, floored at 300s, with special handling for single-test lanes and live-service field-readiness waits.
